note: Coverage groups, not fixed test counts or a framework/class quota. P3 owner outcome does not imply native durability PASS.

groups.title: Startup local PGP request and signing preflight
groups.obligation: Signing protocol; no secret exposure; verified configured identity before substantial implementation.

groups.title: Current checkout and operator work preserved
groups.obligation: Branch/tree/siblings/dirty state, drift and existing index ownership recorded without reset.

groups.title: Current test impact and CodeAnalytics freshness
groups.obligation: Actual MCP calls/index or explicit unavailable evidence plus source/graph/blind-spot fallback.

groups.title: Accepted authoring result survives same-opening read
groups.obligation: Definition, role, step, canvas and template family coverage; accepted identity/receipt not lost.

groups.title: Old read cannot regress acknowledged state
groups.obligation: Both completion orders; native opaque token semantics; read-only reconciliation.

groups.title: Reentry cannot replace pending submission
groups.obligation: Alternate command/Enter/double dispatch gated consistently without freezing harmless typing.

groups.title: Outcomes are classified and not blindly replayed
groups.obligation: Rejected, accepted, accepted with read-back warning and genuinely unknown result have correct recovery.

groups.title: Retired opening cannot update same-ID successor
groups.obligation: Scope/profile/project lifetime/definition/dispose; success/error/finally/notification covered.

groups.title: Canvas/template intent semantics preserved
groups.obligation: No dropped final geometry or retargeted/duplicated import because of new mutation gating.

groups.title: Role Add adopts eligible authoritative selection
groups.obligation: New identity and fields accepted when origin current; no hijack of later user selection.

groups.title: Role Delete clears removed editor correctly
groups.obligation: Survivor and last-role cases; raw draft/validation/submission/dialog cleanup.

groups.title: Actual edited step keeps DecisionRoleKey
groups.obligation: Distinct and nullable bindings, non-first selection/reorder/refresh; other step unmodified.

groups.title: Immutable submissions preserve later field edits
groups.obligation: Definition/role/step fields and hidden metadata reconcile against submitted values.

groups.title: Stable row and raw-number reconciliation
groups.obligation: H1 reproduced/refuted; accepted untouched normalization and later raw input both respected.

groups.title: Submission lifecycle closes on reachable discard/refusal
groups.obligation: H2 reproduced/refuted; no old submission reused after explicit transition.

groups.title: Two openings and Server-tab raw drafts remain independent
groups.obligation: Real renderer input/validation and canvas/dialog identity; no circuit-scoped mutable sharing.

groups.title: Actual cross-scope authoring diagnosis completed
groups.obligation: Native DI/client, new scope and relevant restart/catalog/version observations; not same-instance fake.

groups.title: Native authoring owner outcome delivered
groups.obligation: Bounded existing-owner adapter repair with proof OR implementation-ready authority prerequisite with consumer/schema/lifecycle/test map; not a vague TODO.

groups.title: Durability readiness remains truthful
groups.obligation: Cannot PASS native durability while the proven gap remains; no singleton/UI-cache/template-file workaround.

groups.title: PC1 feature groups carried forward
groups.obligation: All 42 historical groups mapped to current preserved behavior/proof without blanket green inheritance.

groups.title: Affected production projects and light closure validated
groups.obligation: UI/native/Web/sandbox as affected; actual dependency guards and forbidden/unresolved controls.

groups.title: Focused discovery and execution are source-valid
groups.obligation: Exact filters/expected/discovered/executed expanded cases, no stale outputs or zero-test success.

groups.title: Authoring browser journeys demonstrate new corrections
groups.obligation: J1-J3 actual renderer/native seam events and identity/command oracles, not only success labels.

groups.title: Native launch/workflow/files/chat/cancel preserved
groups.obligation: J5 actual owners and no duplicate effects; attributed controlled upstream, not live-provider claim.

groups.title: Affected Workbench/voice/shared chat consumers preserved
groups.obligation: Current invalidation analysis and required concrete tests for both default/typed-child paths.

groups.title: Fast/Parity source and published assets work
groups.obligation: All relevant real children, canvas/dialog/chart/graph/file/chat and no dev-only production endpoint.

groups.title: Owned environments cleaned and private data safe
groups.obligation: Isolated PostgreSQL/ports/outputs/processes; no retained installation/credential/spend side effects.

groups.title: Active renderer and evaluated dependency census delivered
groups.obligation: Real reachability/ownership/asset classification; no interface/file quota or invented next module.

groups.title: Mandatory portability and triggered broader gates recorded
groups.obligation: Current enforcement without write-baseline; named Stable trigger/result or justified no trigger.

groups.title: Tracked source-addressed evidence and signed checkpoints
groups.obligation: Sanitized final summary; separate readiness dimensions; verified incremental English commits.

groups.title: No unsupported performance or full-completion claims
groups.obligation: Measured changes only when invalidated; explicit native-authoring/release limits and honest missing proof.
